text: Why do a T1 (1.544 Mb/s) and an E1 (2.048 Mb/s) differ?
choices: A genuine historical divergence: 24 DS0s plus framing versus 30 DS0s plus signalling, standardised in different regions
explanation: The incompatibility has real consequences for international circuits and persists in carrier price lists today. Both are built from the same 64 kb/s DS0, which derives from Nyquist plus a quantisation decision.
